question: What is our overall return rate?
What was gross profit in 2022?
truth_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.sale_price - p.cost) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned') AND strftime('%Y', oi.created_at) = '2022'

question: Which product category has the highest net revenue?
truth_sql: SELECT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.sale_price) DESC LIMIT 1
